template<class T> struct variant_size;
1
#
All specializations of variant_size meet the
Cpp17UnaryTypeTrait requirements ([meta.rqmts])
with a base characteristic of integral_constant<size_t, N> for some N.
🔗
template<class T> struct variant_size<const T>;
2
#
Let VS denote variant_size<T> of the cv-unqualified
type T.
 Then each specialization of the template meets the
Cpp17UnaryTypeTrait requirements ([meta.rqmts]) with a
base characteristic of integral_constant<size_t, VS​::​value>.
🔗
template<class... Types>
  struct variant_size<variant<Types...>> : integral_constant<size_t, sizeof...(Types)> { };
🔗
template<size_t I, class T> struct variant_alternative<I, const T>;
3
#
Let VA denote variant_alternative<I, T> of the
cv-unqualified type T.
 Then each specialization of the template
meets the Cpp17TransformationTrait requirements ([meta.rqmts]) with a
member typedef type that names the type const VA​::​type.
🔗
variant_alternative<I, variant<Types...>>::type
4
#
Mandates: I < sizeof...(Types).
5
#
